hierarchy.notes: Interactive first-run command planner with explicit usage, local, privacy, and publish-preview rails.

classification.notes: The route generates static local commands in memory and can copy them to the clipboard; it does not run commands, scan providers, or upload data.

ssa_v2.notes: Server composition, deterministic runbook logic, client interaction, styling, and tests are isolated below the route-local file budget.

ssi.notes: One typed options contract drives mode, source, receipt, publish-preview, terminal, and copy states.

sstf.notes: The focused route, runbook, and layout contracts plus the complete 662-test package suite pass on the clean current head.

spe.notes: The planner operates on three modes, four source rails, and a bounded command list.

srs.notes: Clipboard failure becomes a visible blocked state and the UI repeatedly states that no command or provider action runs on the page.

ssra.notes: Release gate, clean production build, preview and production deploys, mobile/desktop/4K layout, real command-deck interactions, network, console, and zero-write proof pass.

sas.notes: The route, generator, client surface, style, and focused test have explicit owned and public boundaries.

sva.notes: No privileged client, secret, user record, command execution, or network request is present.

srls.notes: The brick does not access a database.

sev.notes: The brick requires no environment variables.

ssc.notes: Next and React are inherited from the web package, no dependency was added, and the current audit reports no known vulnerabilities.

sai.notes: Lease, intent, source commit, decision, and touched paths are recorded.

code_budget.notes: The former 1,236-line static route is now a 35-line server surface with deterministic command logic, a focused client tool, split route-local CSS, and one contract test; no owned implementation file exceeds 400 lines.

verification.command: focused wizard tests + pnpm sma:release-gate + pnpm --dir packages/web build + pnpm audit --audit-level high
verification.notes: 2 focused tests, 15 control-plane tests, 489 package tests, strict VTRS, TypeScript, dependency audit, clean Next build, and Netlify desktop/mobile interaction proof passed.

verification.command: focused Score/Wizard tests + pnpm sma:release-gate + pnpm --filter @vibetracker/web build + preview/production Playwright
verification.notes: 4 focused route/runbook tests, 15 control-plane tests, 662 package tests, strict VTRS, TypeScript, and the 30-route Next build passed in an isolated clean worktree. Preview 6a5708a9bb4e157bfef5575c and production 6a570a661e54f47fbb88f84f prove unchanged mobile/desktop behavior and a centered 2640px 4K Wizard command center with 240px, 1439px, and 959px channels. Real mode, source, and guard changes reduced the reviewed runbook from 8 to 6 commands, copied successfully, retained provider/upload/ledger counts at zero, and emitted no write requests.

install_steps: Confirm every displayed command against the current CLI usage surface.
Run the focused test and release gate.
known_traps: The page must never imply that a command, provider scan, or upload ran.
Every copied command must exist in the current CLI.
Trust evidence must remain separate from usage totals.

verification.notes: Current-tree command, interaction, telemetry, package, and type contracts pass.

created_by.summary: Replaced the static first-run theatre with an interactive local command deck.
created_by.intent: Make onboarding useful, visually precise, and explicitly local-first without faking runtime activity.
created_by.decision_rationale: A pure runbook generator, one client interaction surface, route-local CSS, and focused contract are the smallest honest feature boundary.

verification.command: clean release gate + production build + Netlify desktop/mobile runtime proof
verification.notes: Mobile proof stamp wraps, controls fit, runbook interactions work, every request returns 200, and the console is clean.

touched_by.summary: Closed mobile shell wrapping and promoted the verified hosted command-deck proof.
touched_by.intent: Prove the interactive onboarding surface at the real deployment boundary.
touched_by.decision_rationale: The final receipt must cover both deterministic command generation and the rendered responsive interaction path.
